services.name: SUP Yoga
services.desc: Take your yoga practice outside and on the water, with a stand up paddleboard as your mat! Enjoy learning while adapting to the motion of the board, the continuous need to adjust balance, the instability created by minor energy and weight shifts, and the focus required to stay grounded while afloat. Besides reinforcing the proper SUP technique, this activity improves, and makes more challenging, your existing yoga practice: Along with engaging more muscles, by performing poses on a moving surface, achieving perfect alignment becomes crucial in order to distribute weight properly on the board. Right of Way, Launching & Docking, and more… Prerequisites: Participants must be able to swim

services.name: Bug Sailing
services.desc: Appropriate for those with little or no sailing experience, this course teaches all the basics needed to get you out on the water, safely maneuvering your sailboat (a Capri dinghy) around the Lake. In addition, after successfully completing the course, students receive certification so they can rent boats on their own. Tacking and jibing (turning), sail trim, nomenclature, knots, and water safety are among the subjects covered in this fast-paced and exhilarating course taught by experienced, certified instructors. blurb: Guests can take private or group lessons in sailing, windsurfing, kayaking, and standup paddleboarding. The Boathouse rents watersports equipment and offers scouting programs tailored to earning awards or merit badges. The facility is located in a protected wildlife refuge with a daily launch fee for personal equipment.
extraNote: All rental bookings are non-refundable · Daily launch fee of $7 per vessel or yearly launch fee of $150 for personal equipment · Boathouse at Shoreline Lake, Mountain View, CA
